fact: The page states that under Article 6 of Law 21-012/AU the Comoros national digital development agency (ANADEN), through its cybersecurity directorate, was designated the competent national cybersecurity authority, in charge of oversight of information-system and network security and trust services; no date for the designation is given, so the page's published date is used.

The National Digital Development Agency (ANADEN) says Law 21-012/AU, promulgated by decree 22/003/PR, names the national agency as the competent cybersecurity authority and sits within a national cybersecurity strategy.
